scope: source-first HUD/timer audit for bounded frame333 visual comparison

source_logic: time decrements gametime only when zhanting=false and both fighters alive
timer.finding: The source interval is 1000ms and the source frame333 capture is only 371ms after Ready, so source remains 60. Godot starts a real Timer before battle_intro.begin; the deterministic runner can spend over one wall-clock second before capture although only 10 fight ticks elapsed, producing 59. This is a lifecycle/clock anchor mismatch or probe scheduling artifact, not a digit sprite mapping error.
timer.required_scope: integration should compare countdown start/Ready anchor and use source-equivalent scheduling; do not subtract or force the displayed digit in a character probe.

energy_meter.visual_finding: Flash bottom meter is a narrow authored yellow fill with a small source counter frame; Godot draws a wider 112px custom bar with blue/red/green palette and larger counter. This is a shared HUD representation difference, not Byakuya-specific.
energy_meter.required_scope: integration must compile/use source HUD qt/bss timeline assets, placement, masks and authored colors/transforms; do not patch a Byakuya-specific color or width.

acceptance: 333 visual remains bounded and not full parity until timer anchor and shared energy HUD are resolved.
